author: @AaronStGeorge

evidence.api_compatibility: No breaking changes. The version string bump in backend_versions.json and server_models.json is internal configuration; existing config, CLI usage, and API contracts are unaffected. The only behavioral note is @jeremyfowers' observation that the HRX `load()` override drops automatic MTP detection for models that support it (e.g., Qwen3.8-27B), filed as issue #3743 — this is a regression in model feature support, not an API break.
evidence.documentation: No documentation changes are needed. The PR self-certifies 'Documentation is not affected by this change.' The model entries follow the same format as existing entries in server_models.json, so no spec update is required.
evidence.manual_release_testing: The commit modifies only resource JSON files (server_models.json, backend_versions.json) and a test constant. It ships no new API endpoint, CLI command, GUI element, or executable artifact — only catalog data for existing model names and a version bump in backend_versions.json. No manual release to-do is warranted.
evidence.post_approval_commits: No commits were added after the first approval (@superm1 at 2026-10-01T18:31:58Z) or after the latest approval (@jeremyfowers at 2026-10-02T17:10:21Z). The branch was clean through merge.
evidence.review: PR #3723 was approved by @superm1 (first approval, 2026-10-01T18:31:58Z) and @jeremyfowers (latest approval, 2026-10-02T17:10:21Z). @superm1 covers ROCm and llamacpp in the maintainers table — directly relevant to an HRX backend bump. @jeremyfowers covers new backends and CI — also relevant. @jeremyfowers initially requested changes noting that the HRX `load()` override drops MTP support, but said it did not need to block the PR and filed issue #3743 as a follow-up. Both reviewers applied the project's practice of pairing subject-matter expertise with review. No inline review comments were left on the diff. No commits were added after either approval.
evidence.security: No security concerns. The diff changes JSON catalog entries and a version constant. No new network calls, credential handling, code execution paths, or dependency changes. SHA256 checksums for the HRX installer asset are updated in the existing pattern.
evidence.tests: test/cpp/test_hrx_contract.cpp was updated to reflect the new version string (hrx-b99) in two places — the `kReleaseVersion` constexpr and the installer asset filename assertion. This keeps the contract test aligned with the version bump. The 26 new model entries are data (JSON) and have no code path to test in this repo; model correctness is demonstrated by the external ROCm/ggml-staging-automation CI run 36644473249, attempt 5, referenced in the PR description and commit message.

subject: ci(hrx): bump hrx to b99 + add 26 perplexity-verified models (#3723)

verdict_reason: Two-expertise review (ROCm + CI), all checks pass, no post-approval changes, and the data-only changes are well-scoped.
